analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (104,245 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (95,958/114,838/164,141 KRW) — below short-term, mid-term, and long-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (137,070/97,038 KRW) — below mid-long term trend, above long-term trend.
· 52-week position (34.5%) + approaching historical low range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.7→43.4) + exiting oversold, now sideways in neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4318.2272→504.3173) + confirmed improvement, still in negative territory.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 114,838 KRW) + 71.12% band width indicating potential for volatility expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (68,045 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (58,180 KRW) and 52-week low (26,110 KRW).
· Swing resistance (115,010 KRW) + break above would enter resistance zone of SMA20 (114,838 KRW).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + no clear trend reversal signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.62x) + listless movement, reduced confidence.
· Current range diagnosis (Accumulation) + maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of clear directional momentum.
